causal_scope: All estimates remain current cross-sectional stable-type associations. Patron adoption timing and causality are not identified.

families.corrected_rich_controls: Sensitivity only: explicit missing-date handling and disabled/TOS exclusions.

families.price_count_rate: Secondary one-standard-deviation count/rate companions at frozen min-2 and min-4 support.
